content: The Element.replaceWith() method replaces this Element in the children list of its parent with a set of Node objects or strings. Parameter: param1,...,paramN set of Node objects or strings to replace. Return value: undefined. Exceptions: HierarchyRequestError DOMException when the node cannot be inserted.
conclusion: Element.replaceWith() replaces the element in its parent child list with nodes or strings, throwing HierarchyRequestError if insertion is invalid, and returning undefined.
